title: Jimo Borjigin's research on endogenous DMT and terminal lucidity

tellings.quote: >> Yeah, it's fascinating. GMO Borgagen at University of Michigan. She studies stuff around, you know, endogenous DMT receptors in the brain and stuff, but she also studies terminal lucidity,

plain: A University of Michigan scientist named Jimo Borjigin studies DMT, a psychedelic compound, as the brain may make it on its own, and also terminal lucidity, the sudden clarity some people show just before death. Michels brings this up himself while talking with the neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore, without citing a particular paper, as a sign that science is looking at what happens to the mind at death.
